title: Frontend Architect
summary: A frontend architect decides how a company's web front ends are built: the structure of the code, shared component libraries, and the standards for speed, accessibility and testing. It is a senior hands-on role that guides several frontend teams and works with product, design and backend architects.
dailyDuties: Set frontend architecture and coding standards for teams
Review designs and pull requests from several teams
Own the shared component library and design system
Track and improve page speed and Core Web Vitals
Mentor senior and junior frontend engineers
Explain technical options to product and client teams
Build proofs of concept for new tools and patterns

skills.expectation: Set the frontend architecture: app structure, micro-frontends or monorepo, shared code and standards
Have deep, hands-on experience in at least one major framework
Have deep, hands-on experience in at least one major framework
Set TypeScript standards for large codebases
Build or own a component library and design system used by several teams
Set performance budgets and improve Core Web Vitals
Make sure products meet WCAG and fix accessibility issues
Lead and mentor frontend engineers and make architecture decisions
Review designs and pull requests across teams
Explain trade-offs to product, design, backend and client teams
Use server-side rendering with Next.js or a similar framework
Choose state management patterns for large apps
Set the frontend testing strategy with Jest and Testing Library
Set up frontend build and deployment pipelines
Prevent XSS and other browser security issues
